encoding_notes: Publisher per journal's own guide = Korean Society of Spine Surgery (KSSS); some indexers list 'Korean Spine Society'.
ISSN from ISSN portal/DOAJ (not the guide): pISSN 1976-1902, eISSN 1976-7846.
page_size null because the guide accepts BOTH letter (21.6x27.9 cm) and A4 (21.0x29.7 cm).
font.family null because the guide allows three fonts (Arial, Times New Roman, or Courier), all 10 pt.
Right margin unstated; guide gives 3.0 cm top/bottom/left only.
line_numbers='none' is conservative (guide does not request line numbering; unstated).
Original articles cap = 8 FIGURES OR TABLES combined (schema has no combined figure+table cap) so figures_max/tables_max left null.
Reviews: guide groups 'narrative and systematic' together (4,000 words, 30-100 refs); encoded to both narrative_review and systematic_review with identical limits.
et_al_threshold=6 captures 'list all when six or fewer'; guide also says 'when seven or more, list only the first three names, followed by et al.' (two-number rule not fully representable).
Figure DPI tiered: 600 dpi color/grayscale (radiography/halftone), 1,200 dpi line-art; min_dpi encodes the 600 floor.
Figure submission formats JPG/GIF/PPT, final acceptance TIFF/EPS; only jpg/tiff/eps map to the allowed format enum (GIF and PPT dropped).
Declarations order not prescribed by the guide (order=[]); required set = conflict of interest, funding, author contributions (CRediT), data availability (ICMJE), ethics approval (clinical/animal).
abstract_max_words 300 stated for the structured abstract (original articles); left null for review/technical/letter where not separately stated.
Case reports and editorials are accepted but the guide states no type-specific word/reference/figure limits or abstract structure -> nulls.
[schema-required default] layout.margins_mm nulled — guide stated only {'top_mm': 30, 'bottom_mm': 30, 'left_mm': 30} but the schema requires all four edges; a partial margin can't be applied.
2026-07-18 doctrine audit: line_numbers 'none' was a default, not a guide statement — nulled so the engine preserves the author's setting.

2026-07-25 Janine live-guide verification (asianspinejournal.org/authors/authors.php): line_spacing 'double' CONFIRMED - "The text should be typed in 10-point Arial, Times New Roman, or Courier font and double-spaced."

2026-07-25 Janine: SCHEMA GAP on references.et_al_threshold=6. The guide states a TWO-TIER rule - "List names of all authors when six or fewer. When seven or more, list only the first three names, followed by 'et al.'" A single N cannot express it: our engine renders a 7-author reference as 6 + et al., where the journal wants 3 + et al. Value left at 6 (the closer of the two available encodings) pending the richer { list_up_to, then_first } shape specced to Sushant 2026-07-25.
